description: [PAID $0.002 USDC per call via x402 on Base; errors are free] Inspect a token or any address on Base mainnet: contract vs EOA (incl. EIP-7702 delegation), bytecode size, ERC-20 name/symbol/decimals/totalSupply (raw and formatted; bytes32 symbols handled), proxy implementation (EIP-1967, beacon, ZeppelinOS/FiatToken), whether it is a well-known Base token (guards against spoofed symbols), and optionally the balance of `holder`. Read live from public Base RPC; metadata cached 1 h. All params optional: defaults to USDC on Base. Invalid input = 400, never charged.

address.description: Token / contract address on Base (0x + 40 hex). Optional: defaults to USDC 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913.

holder.description: Optional address whose balance of this token to include.
